units.source_text: 看到他仰面朝天倒在高山植物的盆栽里，右手握着手枪，头顶凹陷部位向外淌着血。

en.t: We saw him lying face up in a pot of alpine plants, with a pistol in his right hand and blood flowing from the dented spot on the top of his head.

units.source_text: 托喀尸体旁边趴着一只雌河童，头埋在他的胸膛里，痛哭流涕。

en.t: Beside Tock's body lay a female kappa, her head buried in his chest as she sobbed bitterly.

units.source_text: 我扶雌河童从地上起来（原本我很讨厌触到河童那黏滑的皮肤的），问：“这是发生了什么事啊？”

en.t: I helped the female kappa up from the ground, though I had always hated touching a kappa's slimy skin, and asked, "What happened here?"
